items.title: Adani makes smart ₹3,050 crore bet to power up its metering game
items.summary: Adani Energy Solutions completed the acquisition of IntelliSmart Infrastructure for Rs 3,050 crore. This deal includes acquiring 100 percent equity share capital and redeeming convertible debentures held by NIIF. IntelliSmart provides advanced metering infrastructure and smart gas meters in India. The acquisition was approved by the Competition Commission of India in October. Adani Energy Solutions is part of the Adani Group and focuses on electricity transmission and distribution.

This initiative aligns with Jindal's previous international expansion efforts and leverages Botswana's extensive coal resources, which are essential for catering to local electricity requirements.

items.summary: More than half of airlines expect a slowdown in air travel over the next two to three years, as rising jet fuel prices, higher maintenance costs and aircraft delivery delays weigh on the aviation industry, according to a McKinsey report. The report also highlights the sector's financial challenges, profitability trends and the potential role of artificial intelligence in improving operational efficiency.

items.title: Godrej Properties acquires 31 acres in Indore for new residential project amid strong demand
items.summary: Godrej Properties Ltd has acquired a 31-acre land parcel in Indore for a residential development project. This acquisition will increase the company's presence in the booming Indore property market, where demand is high. The planned development is expected to have a saleable area of approximately 0.7 million square feet. Godrej Properties already has two projects in Indore at advanced stages of completion.

items.title: Food inflation to stay elevated; ICICI Bank sees 25 bps RBI rate hike in December
items.summary: Food inflation in India is projected to remain elevated in the coming months due to a shortfall in crops. The Reserve Bank of India is anticipated to raise interest rates by 25 basis points to manage retail inflation. Factors such as weak monsoon and high energy prices contribute to the rising inflation. Many essential food items are experiencing upward price pressure amid ongoing inflationary trends.

items.title: Desire within US, India to conclude trade deal by G20: ex-US diplomat
items.summary: Negotiations for a phase one trade agreement between the US and India are ongoing and complex. Both countries express a desire to conclude the deal by the upcoming G20 Summit in Florida. Former diplomat Nisha Biswal indicated that significant issues remain, particularly concerning India's comparative advantages. India's Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal stated that the country expects one of the best trade deals with the US.

items.title: Kolkata-Sairang train derailment: Preliminary probe points to faulty braking system
items.summary: A preliminary investigation into the Kolkata-Sairang Express derailment highlighted the malfunction of its main braking system. The BP angle cock was found in an isolated condition, preventing the brakes from engaging properly. Train crew members reported the system was functional before departure from Guwahati. The train, after addressing an earlier braking issue, failed to stop at a signal near Digaru Station.

items.summary: Union Civil Aviation Minister K Rammohan Naidu announced a trilateral committee involving India, Oman, and the UAE. items.title: Retail inflation may remain above 6 pc for next few months; economists see possibility of rate hikes
items.summary: Mumbai's consumer price index-based retail inflation is projected to remain above 6 percent in upcoming months. This rise is attributed to increasing food prices, an adverse base effect, and commodity price impacts. Economists predict that retail inflation will average 6.2 percent in the October-December quarter of FY27. Heightened food prices and weather-related risks pose ongoing challenges for crop production.

items.summary: India's budgeted direct tax collection target for this fiscal year is Rs 26.97 lakh crore. Current collections are at approximately 53 percent of this target as of November 10. Experts flag the need for a rise in corporate tax and advance tax collections in upcoming months. Non-corporate tax collections have shown slower growth compared to corporate tax collections during the same period.

items.title: RBI plans curbs on private equity firms controlling stakes in multiple non-bank lenders: Report
items.summary: India's central bank is working on new rules to prevent private equity firms from holding controlling stakes in multiple non-bank lenders. The proposal aims to mitigate potential financial risks stemming from global private equity firms' investments. While larger stakes will attract greater scrutiny, smaller investments are encouraged to support growth in the financial sector. Recent data shows significant foreign investment in non-bank lenders, highlighting strong demand for credit.
